components.name: Arithmetic-demand/additive-feasibility/non-degenerate-certificate precision layers
components.project_addition: Identify the exact P025 witness precision mu as the restricted first successive minimum of the cube for the additive witness lattice T while forbidding the degeneracy sublattice T^circ; distinguish it from the ordinary first minimum rho and the independent arithmetic-demand floor lambda_abc; and provide exact primitive abc counterexamples where mu exceeds max(lambda_abc,rho), proving that degeneracy/flag state cannot be erased for the non-degenerate-certificate future language. Restricted successive minima and lattice avoidance are prior art; the abc-generated flag plus precision-routing integration is novelty-unverified.
